question: Who among the following Indian Table Tennis players clinched the ITTF Challenger Plus Oman Open 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sharath Kamal.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Achanta Sharath Kamal__ won the ITTF Challenger Plus Oman Open.
 
• He beat top-seeded Marcos Freitas of Portugal 4-2 in the final played in Muscat on 15 Marc
